rules.description: The sound is drowning in reverb or delay, losing its definition.

recommendations.notes: Turn down the Reverb Mix knob in the bottom effects row.
Turn down the Delay Mix knob. Also check if Macro sliders 5-8 are controlling FX levels.

rules.description: After releasing the key, the sound continues for too long (long release tail).

recommendations.notes: Drag the 'R' slider in the Volume Envelope section downwards to shorten the fade-out time.

rules.description: The preset plays a sequence or pattern instead of a sustained note.

recommendations.notes: Click the pyramid-of-dots icon in the Pitch section. If it's orange, the arp is active. Click to turn it grey.

rules.description: The high frequencies are piercing or fatiguing.

recommendations.notes: Turn down the main Filter Cutoff knob. Also check Macro 1, which often controls brightness.
Enable the Master Filter (bottom left) and set it to 'LP 12dB' to roll off highs.

rules.description: FLEX is causing audio glitches or high CPU load.

recommendations.notes: Check if any Macro controls 'Unison' or 'Voices' and turn it down.
Increase your audio buffer size in FL Studio settings.
